notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR3 runs a procedure-name-1 subject's debugging section "Immediately before each execution of the named procedure" and immediately after an ALTER that references it. FinalizeDebug/AddNamedDebugSubject record a paragraph subject at its pc and, since PB5414 landed, AddDebugSectionSubject records a section subject with its SubjectEndPc, so EmitDebugRunner fires it only when control reaches the section from outside it (__dbgFrom); AlterSwitchEmitter.EmitDebugTriggers fires after an ALTER of the subject. Probed at 85: paragraph P2: PERFORM P2 [24][P2][PERFORM LOOP], GO TO P2 [33][P2][ ], altered GO TO [38][P2][ ]; section S2: PERFORM S2 runs once though a loop GO TO Q1 iterates, PERFORM Q1, PERFORM Q2 and GO TO Q2 from outside run nothing, PERFORM Q1 THRU Q2 PERFORM LOOP, fall-through from S1 FALL THROUGH (line of the previous statement), GO TO Q1 OF S2 from outside [46][S2][ ]; an ALTER whose TO operand is the subject runs nothing at the ALTER (the documented reading of GR3 b/GR17, docs/conformance/3/D-DEBUG-PROCEDURE); --std 2002 COBOL0902.
